Define Parametric Distribution

Source: R/surv_parametric.r
define_surv_param.Rd

Alias for define_surv_flexsurv(). Define a parametric survival distribution using flexsurv's native parameterization.

Usage

define_surv_param(distribution, ...)

Arguments

distribution

a parametric survival distribution (see define_surv_flexsurv() for supported distributions).

...

distribution parameters (see define_surv_flexsurv() for details).

Value

a surv_parametric object.

Examples


define_surv_param(distribution = "exp", rate = .5)
#> An exponential distribution (rate = 0.5).
define_surv_param(distribution = "gompertz", rate = .5, shape = 1)
#> A Gompertz distribution (shape = 1.0, rate = 0.5).
